messages:
Claire: quick one — spotted a tiny auth snippet regress in the new hello quickstart after the SDK migration. PR preview shows a missing env var doc and the Python example still uses old client init. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834
Sam: looking now, thanks. i can push a one-line patch to the snippet. the failing CI on preview is just the snippet rendering error (code fence lang mismatch) so should be quick.
Anish: yep saw the build logs: `docs-preview` failing at `snippets/hello/python.md` line ~24 with `NameError: RedwoodClient` in the exec harness. probably because we didn't import os in the example.
Maya: for consistency i think we should also add a short migration note (SDK v7 -> v8) under the quickstart: mention env var REDWOOD_API_KEY vs old token param. tiny callout, not a whole page.
Claire: good call. Sam — can you: (1) add `import os` to the python snippet, (2) update init to `RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))`, (3) add a 1-line migration note under the auth section?
Sam: on it. pushing branch `docs/834-hello-auth-fix` now. patch preview:```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("hello world")
print(resp.text)
```
Sam: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834/files — added import + migration note. left a TODO to update the shell snippet to show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` instead of `REDWOOD_TOKEN`.
Anish: small nit — can we also add `yarn dev:docs` to the contributor note for local testing? that was what i used to repro.
Sam: done, added a one-liner in CONTRIBUTING.md and in the PR description.
DocsBot: build/preview passed for PR 834 — live preview URL: https://deploy-preview-834--docs.redwood.ai
Maya: quick review done. wording suggestion: "Set REDWOOD_API_KEY in your environment (preferred)" instead of the imperative only. small grammar tweak.
Claire: approved, thanks everyone. Sam please merge when green. :thumbsup:
Sam: merged and backported to `stable` branch. closing thread. :party:
